findings.claim: checkSkillsNamed is a generation-wide gate that every runtime shares. It requires `skills/<id>/SKILL.md` for every "`<id>` skill" mention in a role body, although only opencode needs that file, because opencode alone injects skills by path. A body that names a skill supplied from outside `skills/` now makes Generate and Check fail for all four runtimes.
evidence: The diff calls checkSkillsNamed from build() for every role and for the foreman, before r.project.
The only existence test is os.Stat(repoRoot/skills/<id>/SKILL.md); no per-runtime scoping.
The new test covers only the missing-file case.

findings.claim: The foreman body is not pinned for opencode skill injection: the end-to-end test skips `foreman`, and the launch test covers only the builder and the reviewer.

evidence: Read the complete diff of 1d0aabf7 (agentgen.go, artifacts_test.go, roles_test.go, roles/skills.go and its test, opencode_contracts.go and its test, opencodeprompt/derive.go, derive_test.go, source.go).
